notes.sowing: Sow outdoors 2 to 6 weeks before your last frost, as soon as the soil can be worked, {cm:2.5} to {cm:5} deep and {cm:7.5} apart. Seed sprouts slowly in soil below about {c:10}. For a fall crop, sow again in late summer.
notes.care: Put up netting or twiggy supports at sowing: tall varieties reach {cm:180}, dwarf ones about {cm:45}. Young plants take light frost, but flowering and pod set stop above {c:29}. Water well once flowering starts.
notes.harvest: Pick garden peas when pods are full but still bright green, snow peas while flat, and snap peas when plump and crisp. Quality fades within a day or two, so pick every couple of days.
